author: Adrian Prandle
content: First time using Dancing Cubs and found them very professional - prompt responses to emails from Zara, and they contacted us when running late so we knew when to expect the equipment. Everything was set up in time for the party starting and Matthew was a friendly and efficient delivery/pick-up driver. The deposit was returned very swiftly afterwards. Oh, and most importantly the children had lots of fun with the things we hired. Thanks!
